title: Survey of Novel Deep Learning Architectures for Denoising Gravitational-wave Signals
abstract: arXiv:2609.13272v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gravitational-wave denoising must handle the full diversity of spinning, precessing binaries, since the recovered waveform underpins parameter estimation, tests of general relativity, and population studies. Matched filtering achieves this at a cost that becomes prohibitive as next-generation detectors push event rates higher; deep learning offers real-time reconstruction, but current methods are developed on narrow parameter spaces, precluding principled comparison and reliable deployment. We present the first controlled comparison of five neural-network architectures for gravitational-wave denoising, trained identically across the full astrophysically-motivated spinning binary-black-hole parameter space. A unifying principle emerges: matching network structure to the spectral anatomy of a coalescence -- inspiral, merger, ringdown -- outperforms brute-force model scaling. translated_title: 引力波信号去噪的新型深度学习架构综述
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.13272v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：引力波去噪必须能够处理自旋、进动双星系统的全部多样性，因为恢复出的波形是参数估计、广义相对论检验以及族群研究的基础。匹配滤波虽然能实现这一目标，但随着下一代探测器推动事件率不断提高，其计算成本变得难以承受；深度学习可以提供实时重构，但目前的方法都是在狭窄的参数空间中开发的，无法进行有原则的比较和可靠的部署。我们首次对五种用于引力波去噪的神经网络架构进行了受控比较，这些网络在完整的基于天体物理动机的自旋双黑洞参数空间中以相同方式训练。研究发现了一个统一的原则：使网络结构与双星并合过程的光谱结构——旋近、并合、铃宕——相匹配，其效果优于单纯依靠暴力扩大模型规模。我们的多尺度频率感知架构正体现了这一原则……
tldr: 本文首次在完整的自旋双黑洞参数空间上对五种引力波去噪神经网络架构进行了受控比较，发现使网络结构与并合信号旋近、并合、铃宕三个阶段的光谱特征相匹配，比单纯扩大模型规模更有效。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first controlled comparison of five neural-network architectures for gravitational-wave denoising, trained identically across the full spinning binary-black-hole parameter space, showing that matching network structure to the spectral anatomy of coalescence (inspiral, merger, ringdown) outperforms brute-force model scaling.
